feature: connectivity tracker setState lock-free fast path

candidate.design: Tracker.set_state compared an atomic state snapshot and the abandoned-waiter flag, returning before the tracker mutex when the requested state was already published and no waiter cleanup was pending.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

conclusion: The 0.8% median improvement was not robust: one round regressed 1.7% and another 5.4%, and the change adds a new state-snapshot consistency obligation. The source change was reverted; the accepted tracker prune fast path remains.
